observed_behavior.wkb: Produces identical two-dimensional Point WKB bytes in NDR and XDR order.
observed_behavior.ewkb: Produces identical two-dimensional Point EWKB bytes with SRID 4326 in NDR and XDR order.

observed_behavior.codecs: The live corpus agrees on GeoJSON, WKT, EWKT, WKB, and EWKB semantics for every supported geometry family and both WKB byte orders.
observed_behavior.spatial: The live corpus agrees on polygon location and WGS84 geography distance within the documented tolerances.

local_profile.crs: Explicit positive SRID metadata with no implicit transformation.
local_profile.extended_codecs: PostGIS EWKT and EWKB with mandatory positive top-level SRID metadata.
